text: A configured part can declare its test budget, test_minutes in .invariant/repository.json, in whole minutes from the default 10 to 55 (#487). The loader refuses any other value when the file loads, naming the part, its value and the limit, so a gate refuses it in CI too. 55 is a hard ceiling in place of the watcher flag #487 asked for: it is the longest built-in budget, internal/verify's, the only one a real-image check has measured, and a build's last test run and the factory's own check, at most 57 minutes each, fit inside a watcher's 150-minute run with time for the agent and its review. A check gets the longest budget among the parts it selects and a whole run two minutes longer, as ten minutes are inside twelve; selection keeps the ordinary deadline until it establishes a longer one, as built-in ownership discovery does. check-repository's own bound grows to the longest any part of the base's contract declares. A part that declares nothing keeps ten minutes inside twelve, and a contract without the field serializes as before, so ratified plans' execution digests don't change. Every check's summary says which budget it ran under and, when its test budget or whole run ran out, which. A gate or watcher built before this commit refuses the field, and the new budgets reach the factory only in watchers rebuilt from main after it merges.
